dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a non-linear spline curvature from the posterior base to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological highest point characterized by an obtuse pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear to slightly convex anterior margin oriented at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate ratio of 1.5:1 base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small white punctate marks across the lateral surface and minor nicks along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white salt-and-pepper speckling distributed throughout the dark epidermal surface of the fin.
